name: ai.userintuition/research
title: User Intuition
description: Qualitative research with real people: AI-moderated interviews, 4M+ vetted panel, 80+ languages.

tools.name: create_study
tools.description: Start a qualitative research study with real people: AI-moderated in-depth interviews (user interviews, customer interviews, market research; the moderator probes and ladders, typically 20–30 minutes), concept tests (packaging, claims, ad creative, designs), or prototype tests (clickable prototypes, websites, landing pages), by voice, video or chat in 80+ languages. Participants come from a 4M+ vetted consumer panel, your own customers by email, or synthetic respondents. Use for "interview N shoppers about X", "test this concept with real people", "why did customers churn / switch / buy", win-loss, onboarding. Not for multiple-choice surveys. Creates an in-depth-interview, concept-test, or prototype-test draft using ordinary metadata only. Choose recruiting_method from the brief: panel when User Intuition should recruit real participants, byop when the user will supply their own participants, or synthetic_respondents when the brief calls for simulated participants. Ask only if the recruiting method is unclear. Unless the human requests otherwise, use a voice interview in English with the male interviewer voice; these defaults are applied when interview_format, language, or voice are omitted. Synthetic respondents require chat. A prototype-test must use video or voice, never chat. Do not draft or pass the study plan, audience targeting, screener questions, concept links, or concept images here; they come from the user's natural-language research brief in the next call. For a concept test, pass an accessible attachment through customize_study.concept_image or include a publicly downloadable concept-image URL in the message, plus its participant-facing label, stimulus context, audience, and learning goals. For a prototype test, include the prototype URL, participant-facing label, intended tasks, audience, and learning goals. customize_study validates and attaches the asset. Voice configuration is kept for chat as well as voice and video. Next: send the brief to queue_customize_study.

name.description: Short internal label, max 40 characters (e.g. "Frozen pizza switchers US").

study_type.description: Use concept-test for a participant-facing concept image and prototype-test for a clickable prototype, staging site, live page, or web flow. Prototype tests require video or voice, never chat.

recruiting_method.description: Choose from the brief: panel to recruit real participants, byop to invite the user’s own participants, or synthetic_respondents for simulated participants. Ask only if the recruiting method is unclear.

interview_format.description: Interview mode. Defaults to voice when omitted.

voice.description: Interviewer configuration for every format, including chat. Defaults to male when omitted.

language.description: Interview language code from userintuition://catalog/languages. Defaults to English (`en`).

tools.name: customize_study
tools.description: Draft or revise a study's discussion guide, interview questions, screener, and audience from the research brief, one design turn per call. May fetch a researcher-provided concept URL. Clients that support MCP background tasks receive a task for turns without concept_image; wait on that task for the result. Calls with concept_image return the result directly. Put operational workflow constraints in execution_policy, never in message. Set decisions=agent only when the human delegated research-design choices; report assumptions and relay only remaining required questions. Otherwise use human mode and relay questions[]. If the client exposes an attached image as bytes or a readable local path, ask for a participant-facing label when missing, base64-encode the raw bytes, and send concept_image. Completed plans and setting changes are persisted. Then get_study, return the full saved plan for review, and obtain approval before invitations or paid launch.

tools.name: get_study
tools.description: Get the full persisted study, including the plan, audience targeting, screeners, and concept assets managed by customize_study. Call before metadata updates and after customization to verify the result. After customization, return the complete persisted study_plan to the user in a readable form. Panel launch approval happens in the launch_panel MCP App, or explicit human chat confirmation when the client does not support Apps. Obtain explicit approval of the current plan before BYOP participant creation; retain study_id and updated_at so unchanged approval survives a resumed workflow. When provisioning_status is provisioned, include both returned links in the completion response. dashboard_url is the researcher management link. study_link is the live participant interview link, not a test or preview link; opening it starts the participant experience. The public API does not expose a separate researcher-preview URL.

tools.name: estimate_panel
tools.description: Estimate the cost and timeline of recruiting real interview participants from User Intuition's 4M+ vetted consumer panel for one study, without spending. Returns per-interview and total cost before any commitment. Read-only estimate for one Panel recruitment cycle. Returns per-interview and total credit cost, available balance and deficit, participant reward, card hold, recurrence, and a heuristic timeline. launch_panel shows this estimate for human App approval, or human chat confirmation in clients without Apps, before the paid request. The price and balance can change before launch; use submit_feasibility_request for low-incidence audiences.

tools.name: launch_panel
tools.description: Recruit real interview participants from User Intuition's 4M+ vetted consumer panel. If an owner or admin enabled automatic launches in Wallet, this tool launches one cycle within the workspace cap with a current estimate and idempotency key. Otherwise, the first call previews the saved plan and complete current panel estimate; nothing is spent until a human explicitly approves. For App clients, a human must click Approve and launch in the App. For clients without MCP Apps, return the saved plan and quote in chat, ask the human to confirm, then call this tool again with the returned chat_approval_nonce and human_confirmed=true. Never infer confirmation from a prior study or quote. The estimate must match the study, country, inputs, balance and price at approval time.

tools.name: chat_research_session
tools.description: Ask a multi-turn question about your User Intuition studies and get an answer grounded in verified participant quotes. Waits for the answer; use queue_research_chat to return immediately. If still running, returns the same durable job without cancelling it. For findings, feedback, comparisons and quotations from your User Intuition studies, use this tool; answers are grounded in document search over the session sources with verified quotations. Resolve ambiguous study names first. Reuse the selected research session; if absent create one with create_research_session and a stable retry key, inspect sources and add only missing requested studies. Do not resync unchanged sources or broaden the session silently. After completion always call view_research_answer to display the answer and clickable quote/recording cards inside this conversation, without redirecting to a dashboard; preserve the answer and citation labels. Poll inspect_research_session view=job. Set parent_job_id for a follow-up in the same session. Reuse the same idempotency_key and prompt after a timeout; sync and async share the job.

Keep session_id and job_id for follow-ups. Set reference_label to read one cited quotation and its transcript/recording context. Preserves backend citation labels; never invent sources.

tools.name: start_research_analysis
tools.description: Start a durable analysis across the session sources. exhaustive processes every eligible interview; quick retrieves verified evidence through document search; aggregate computes exact counts; explore runs bounded computation. Poll get_research_analysis. Prefer chat_research_session or queue_research_chat for questions and generate_research_output for saved outputs. Completed or partial runs can produce presentations, clips or reels; retain coverage and limitations. Reuse the idempotency key on uncertain retries.

tools.name: queue_research_deliverable
tools.description: Use report_video for Highlights: generate one retained MP4 from the studies' default reports, with branded logo bookends, learning-goal chapters and their cited Quotes. Repeated requests return the saved video. No evidence selection is needed. Also supports an editable PowerPoint, an individual audio clip or a legacy audio reel ZIP from a completed/partial research analysis run. Use exact evidence_ids returned by get_research_analysis highlights; presentations include all findings. Audio requires explicit export instruction. Text masking defaults on. Poll get_research_deliverable, or wait on the MCP background task when the client supports tasks. Private links last 15 minutes; temporary audio and presentation files expire in seven days; report videos are retained while their source remains available. Reuse the idempotency key after a timeout.

tools.name: queue_research_chat
tools.description: Same as chat_research_session but returns a job immediately; use when the answer may take longer than the client's tool timeout. For findings, feedback, comparisons and quotations from your User Intuition studies, use this tool; answers are grounded in document search over the session sources with verified quotations. Resolve ambiguous study names first. Reuse the selected research session; if absent create one with create_research_session and a stable retry key, inspect sources and add only missing requested studies. Do not resync unchanged sources or broaden the session silently. After completion always call view_research_answer to display the answer and clickable quote/recording cards inside this conversation, without redirecting to a dashboard; preserve the answer and citation labels. Poll inspect_research_session view=job. Set parent_job_id for a follow-up in the same session. Reuse the same idempotency_key and prompt after a timeout; sync and async share the job.

tools.name: configure_external_panel

Supply completion and screen-out redirect URLs; set the provider's respondent ID query parameter and placeholder if the defaults differ. Optional session, external study, quota-full, and technical-failure mappings are supported. Before sharing entry_url with the provider, call get_study, verify provisioning_status=provisioned, and have the human approve the current plan and URL mapping. This does not recruit respondents or launch the paid User Intuition Panel. Repeating the same PUT preserves the current entry token.
